result.summary: Found 2 visual/content issues. The most obvious broken item is an invalid delivery price showing as NaN, and the fixed bottom navigation appears to overlap the feed content at the bottom of the screen.

issues.description: The restaurant card for “Smash Bros Burgers” displays “€NaN delivery”, which is a broken numeric value exposed to the user.
issues.suggestion: Add validation/fallback formatting for delivery fees. If the value is missing or invalid, show a safe label such as “Delivery fee unavailable”, “Free delivery”, or hide the fee until data is available.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlaps/cuts off the restaurant card content near the bottom of the screen, making the pizza card appear partially hidden.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards are not obscured by the fixed bottom navigation.
